units.source_text: 但是，每当她吃完一盘菜肴的时候，就会突然出现新的菜肴，弥漫着诱人的香味送到她面前。

en.t: But whenever she finished one dish, a new dish would suddenly appear, wafting an enticing aroma as it was brought before her.

units.source_text: 她还没来得及动筷子，就有一只香味四溢的烤雏鸡振翅而飞，拨倒了绍兴美酒，在天花板上拍打翅膀。

en.t: Before she could even move her chopsticks, a fragrant roast spring chicken flapped its wings and flew up, knocked over the fine Shaoxing wine, and beat its wings against the ceiling.
